paragraphs: Rav Achi before Rav Yosef, Eruvin 10a. Rav Achi forbids; Rav Ashi permits, Bava Metzia 90b. It requires examination whether this is one man or the early Rav Ashi. Rav Achi was academy head in the Land of Israel in Rav Huna’s time (see Shalshelet Hakkabbalah 34b). Rabbi Chizkiyah, Rabbi Achi in Rabbi Abbahu’s name, Jerusalem Talmud, Sanhedrin, chapter 4, halakhah 7. Rabbi Achi in Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani’s name, Seder Olam and Yalkut, I Kings, section 3.
